chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, destined the destinies and arranged the plans two thousand years before the creation of Adam.
ai.seo_question: When did Allah predestine the destinies according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the Shia doctrine of *al-Qadr* by specifying that Allah’s decree and administrative planning (*tadbir*) were established two thousand years prior to the creation of Adam. This temporal marker highlights the pre-existence of divine will in the realm of knowledge before its manifestation in the physical world, a concept often linked to the *Kitab al-A'lam* or the Preserved Tablet in Shia exegesis. It serves to affirm that human affairs are not random but are intricately woven into a pre-ordained cosmic order known to God from eternity.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-44 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
Indeed the Honorable the Exalted God has destined the destinies, and has designed the plans two-thousand years before the Creation of Adam.”
